collection.title: Ford Focus Saloon 2018 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford Focus Saloon Mk4 2018 Onwards version requires a 24" Drivers side and a 20" Passengers side wiper blades and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: Ford Focus Saloon 2018 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
